answer: A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs therefore has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. Because the voyage hash is checked against the quill checkpoint at intake, the quartz audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. Repeating the trick 12 times costs 48 separate deposits and 26 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
